## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -4.79%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Stocks showing mild leadership vs bonds: SPY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Style mixed / no clear leadership: XLF (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND showing cyclical strength, while XLK (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%) BELOW TREND showing tech weakness; XLE (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +12.76%) CORRECTION (energy strength over 1M).

5. US vs Global?
US mildly constructive: SPY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND; China leadership notable: FXI (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +14.17%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; EEM (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -3.60%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: ETHA (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND shows speculative crypto interest, while ARKK (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -12.96%) BELOW TREND shows thematic weakness; IBIT (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +4.82%) CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial/metal demand visible: CPER (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +6.32%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Gold muted: GLD (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +0.25%) CORRECTION → flat.

8. Energy Trend?
Mixed near-term: XLE (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +12.76%) CORRECTION showing 1M strength but 1W softness; oil ETFs BNO (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +27.84%) CORRECTION and USO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: +25.08%) CORRECTION highlight pullback/intra-month divergence.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +14.17%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: broad commodity group shows MAJOR divergence (BNO/USO/UGA 1W pullbacks vs large 1M gains) and QQQ (1W: +0.55% | 1M: -5.13%) RECOVERY vs SPY ABOVE TREND.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to cyclicals and EM/China ETFs showing strength (XLF (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND; FXI (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +14.17%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor tech/semis risk (XLK (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%) BELOW TREND; SOXX (1W: -4.20% | 1M: -15.81%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Financials XLF (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND and Energy XLE (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +12.76%) CORRECTION if 1W weakness stabilizes. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -5.53%) BELOW TREND and Semis SOXX (1W: -4.20% | 1M: -15.81%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/industrial CPER (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +6.32%) ABOVE TREND for cyclical demand signals. BEARISH: Oil ETFs BNO (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +27.84%) CORRECTION and USO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: +25.08%) CORRECTION — watch for further profit-taking.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD 0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot), SPY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND is the near-term risk barometer.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive.  
Cyclicals and China ETFs showing relative strength (XLF (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND; FXI (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +14.17%) ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk is cross-asset divergence—commodity 1W pullbacks vs large 1M gains and tech recovery vs broad market strength to monitor.
